description: Renders an interactive 2D structure diagram of a molecule from its SMILES notation. Displays the molecule image along with computed molecular properties (molecular weight, LogP, H-bond donors/acceptors, TPSA, etc.). Use this whenever a user asks to see, visualize, draw, or display a chemical structure.

smiles.description: SMILES notation of the molecule (e.g. 'CCO' for ethanol, 'c1ccccc1' for benzene, 'CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O' for aspirin)

name: render_molecule
title: Render Molecule
